subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my earlier email about paid-subscription growth for {Brand}. Noom's GLP-1 engagement report from February 2026 showed its most-engaged members stayed on program 2.2x longer, which is pushing this category to bid on renewal-weighted value. With healthy blended cost per trial running $20 to $40 and Health and Fitness trials converting to paid near 39.9%, the gap between a cheap trial and a renewing subscriber is where real cost per subscriber gets decided. We run a randomized holdout so paid subscribers show as incremental. Worth comparing against your current source mix?
angle: fresh angle: Noom GLP-1 engagement report (Feb 2026, sourced) + US H&F cost-per-trial band $20-$40 and 39.9% trial-to-paid
register_notes: Stage 2 EN health_and_fitness: acknowledges second follow-up and references prior email; fresh angle = timely Noom GLP-1 engagement report (Feb 2026) + verified US H&F cost-per-trial band $20-$40 and 39.9% trial-to-paid; market numbers web-verified with URLs in enrichment_sources; Noom reused from parent brands only, no new brand; MobUpps holdout referenced with no figure; 1 question mark; native English; no sign-off; no X-not-Y negation; no hedge before figures.
